body:
My 2 best friends went to a party (but I did not go), we just thought they were going to get drunk and smoke some bud but the day they got back they called me and told me they got magic mushrooms,see I have been wanting to try them forever but I couldnt cause I didnt go to the party.abouttwo weeks later me and my friends saved up money and bought a piece and a half of halloween candy (magic mushrooms grounded up and baked into chocolate, it looks like a white chocolate reeses cup with gree mettalic specks on it often with a design on it like a flower or smiling face).
As soon as we got it we divided it all up and ate it this was at 12:30.about 15 minutes later we started to come up and we were laughing and stuff then at about 1:15 I got the full effects I sat down on his couch and my whole body was numb and I was staring at the ceiling seeing blue dots bouncing everywhere and a big black hole in the corner.it felt as if I was going into an out of body experience.now the time is 2:00 and I jumped out his window and smoked a cigarette, weel I hadnt smoked for about a week (cause I chew snuff) and that really got me buzzing and I started seeing evil objects forming out of shadows so I ran in. Then we just chilled in the dark looking at trippy things like his posters and stuff.now it was like 3:30 and we were coming down busting out laughing at the stupidest things,cause we were watching tv. And now I just cant get that same experience as my first time.Mad TV and magic mushrooms mix well, I
enjoyed watching it while tripping or watching pink floyds the walls.
